'''Education system''' generally refers to the institutions and structured resource dedicated to [[education]].

== Public education systems ==

In many parts of the word, some education is provided as a public service, often through government-funded learning institutions, such as public schools and universities. 

Access to public education is often free or heavily subsidised, especially for those who cannot otherwise afford it.

== Common challenges ==

=== Industrial standardisation ===

According to British educator specialist [[Person:Ken Robinson|Sir Ken Robinson]], modern education systems are frequently guilty of industrial standardisation, focusing on "most useful subjects for work" and ignoring innate creativity of children and human diversity. He criticises the current education systems for "educating people out of their creative capacities.<ref>{{#cite:Q2030}}</ref>
